Fixes from the community since 4.17.3. Still built on upstream [v4.17.1](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/releases/tag/v4.17.1).

### Fixes

- **`sst remove` no longer fails on the certificate of an `Alb` or `Service` load balancer.** The load balancer is now removed before its certificate, so the remove doesn't stop with `ResourceInUseException` while the load balancer still holds it. Existing stacks get the new ordering with no resource changes. ([#42](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/42), [anomalyco/sst#6934](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6934))
- **A Step Functions `Task` with `timeout` deploys.** It was written as `Timeout`, which Step Functions rejects. It's now `TimeoutSeconds`. ([#24](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/24), [anomalyco/sst#6985](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/6985))

### Changes

- **`sst init` recognises SvelteKit 3 apps**, which have no `svelte.config.js`, and installs `@sst-community/svelte-kit-sst` under the name `svelte-kit-sst`. The SvelteKit guide shows the `vite.config.ts` setup, with a note for SvelteKit 2. ([#28](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/28), [anomalyco/sst#6994](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/issues/6994))
- **API Gateway components look up the API Gateway account once per provider**, not once per gateway. Deploys of apps with many gateways make fewer calls; no resources change. ([#33](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/33), [anomalyco/sst#6912](https://github.com/anomalyco/sst/pull/6912))

### Docs

- The README links the SvelteKit guide. ([#43](https://github.com/sst-community/sst/pull/43))
- The published docs show when each page was last changed.

### Install

```bash
npm install sst@npm:@sst-community/sst@4.17.4
```

To switch an existing project, set its dependency to `"sst": "npm:@sst-community/sst@4.17.4"` and reinstall. Without Node:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sst-community/sst/main/install | bash
```
